description: The Business Case establishes a grounded value premise tied to hypotheses, credible ROI/benefit expectations, realistic risk assessments, and sound business alternatives -- approve it to authorize project chartering
The Business Case fails to justify investment, presents unviable economics or unsubstantiated value premises -- reject it outright
The Business Case requires further financial justification, risk quantification, or clearer hypothesis-to-benefit linkage before it can be judged
